routes.independence: route B contains no executable import of route A; the test parses route B's AST and asserts this. Route B recomputes affine dimension by affine closure instead of Gaussian elimination, cosets by closure instead of generator-tuple subspace enumeration, the union predicate by recursive exact cover instead of maximal-piece combinations, class accuracies by truth-table enumeration instead of per-cell argmax identities, modular membership by the row/column-count characterization instead of triple enumeration, the monomial count by direct subset summation instead of the Moebius butterfly, and the cycle rank by union-find spanning-forest counting instead of the edge-vertex-component formula.
